title: The home screen: a globe to spin
kaylee: The old map is now a toy globe she spins with her finger. Every country is a little window on it, and Sparkle's balloon flies down to the one she taps.
questions: Canada's pin shows Maple in her canoe. Keep it, or bring the moose back?
Thailand's pin shows Krabi (the elephant and the islands). Or should it be Agong's house?

links.label: The same with a mouse's words

pictures.title: iPad
pictures.caption: The pins are circles cut from each country's shelf banner, with its flag. No generated art, no emoji.

pictures.title: iPad, upright
pictures.caption: A globe is round, so it fills either way up. The map left half the screen empty.

pictures.title: iPhone
pictures.caption: Pins stay a full finger wide (64px here, 88px or more on the iPad).
